label: General system
instructions: Judge system and service events from the supplied lines only.

criteria.normal: Successful operation or routine informational event without a problem.
criteria.warning: Degraded performance, retry, or recoverable issue without a confirmed failure.
criteria.error: Failed operation, exception, unavailable service, or data loss.
criteria.security: Authentication abuse, unauthorized access, attack, or security policy violation.
criteria.other: Insufficient context or none of these categories apply.
